name: SpellCheckSuggestionsToolbar
description: Menu-backed toolbar for the spell check replacements of the misspelled word under an editable text cursor: up to three suggestion rows in the menu popup surface.

theme.note: No theme of its own: the rows and surface resolve the menu component's MenuTheme/MenuPopupTheme.

accessibility.keyboard: the rows are standard menu rows (ArrowUp/Down traversal, Enter/Space activates); the framework's editable text toolbar owns focus and dismissal
accessibility.semantics: every suggestion is a menu button; disabled rows dim to 50% opacity

sizes.toolbar: up to 3 rows; no icon or shortcut column

notes: A misspelled word without suggestions shows one disabled row labelled from ShadcnLocalizations.spellCheckNoSuggestions (English fallback; no ARB equivalent).
MenuPopup/MenuButton come from the menu component; the toolbar declares no copy of them.
Anchoring is the same TextFieldTapRegion + Stack/Positioned contract the framework's toolbar builder expects.
